about: Icastico key-binding library (ADR 0011). Every function a notation editor needs, with its Finale and Logic Pro keys. 'command' = implemented in Icastico; functions without it are planned. Key syntax: Mod = Ctrl (Windows) / Cmd (Mac), Alt = Alt / Option. source: doku = from the program's documentation, annahme = our guess (please verify), icastico = our own addition.
